summary: Full e2e testing of The Honey Woods hotel MVP. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (packages, rooms, reviews, inquiries CRUD + validation + descending order). Frontend: hero renders with animated reveal, nav smooth-scrolls, packages tab switcher works (5 <-> 3 itinerary items), inquire button scrolls to contact and preselects package, valid form submission succeeds with success toast and clears form, review dots present, no broken images.

integration_issues.issue: HTML5 `required` attributes on name/email/phone inputs pre-empt the custom sonner error toast in Contact.jsx. When the user clicks Send inquiry on an empty form, the browser's native tooltip shows and blocks submission — the `toast.error('Please fill in your name, email and phone.')` branch never fires. Functionally the form is still validated; but the test-case wording ("submitting empty form shows a sonner toast error") is technically not met. To honor the spec, remove `required` on the three inputs OR call e.preventDefault() and add novalidate to the form.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In /app/frontend/src/components/Contact.jsx, add `noValidate` on the <form> and remove `required` from the three inputs so the custom sonner toast for empty submission fires as spec'd. Current behavior still validates via browser-native UI.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `create_inquiry` inserts `doc` (a dict) into Mongo — Motor mutates it by adding `_id`. Currently harmless because response uses `inq` (Pydantic model), not `doc`. Fine as-is.
server.py: `@app.on_event('shutdown')` is deprecated in FastAPI; consider lifespan handler.
Contact.jsx & Packages.jsx & Reviews.jsx duplicate `const API = ${process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api;` — extract into shared api client.
Contact.jsx: `required` attrs conflict with the intended sonner toast validation flow (see integration issue).
Hero.jsx: hero image URL is Unsplash direct link — dependent on external CDN availability.
seed_data_creation: Test inquiries prefixed with TEST_ were created in Mongo `honeywoods_db.inquiries` collection during backend + frontend testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Frontend uses Lenis smooth scroll — for scroll assertions use window.__lenis.scrollTo(el) or wait ~2.5s after triggering. Sonner toasts render at top-center with selector `[data-sonner-toast]`. RESEND_API_KEY is empty by design → email_sent must always be false. Only known minor is HTML5 `required` blocking sonner empty-form toast (see integration_issues).
